title: DINNER LADY 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid – Kiwi Melon – Fruit Flavours
description:
Dinner Lady’s Melon twist plays between sweet and tangy flavour. A juicy melon flavour is rushed to your taste buds on inhale and balanced with tart kiwi taste on exhale for a truly unique vape.
Flavour:
Melon
VG/PG:
70% VG, 30% PG
Bottle size:
60ml filled with 50ml for your nicotine shot.
Nicotine Level:
Zero – 0mg
